description: Decision-grade stress extension to the already executed mini baseline; synthetic/public data only. One final bounded run before provider/model market screening.

fixtures.description: Intent semantics should resolve an event rather than a person sharing the same label.
fixtures.input:
User: "Move the dentist to Friday."
Eligible candidates:
P1 = Person, Dr. Rossi, dentist.
E1 = Event, dental appointment with Dr. Rossi, Thursday 15:00.
No other dentist-related event exists.
fixtures.instructions: Use the requested operation and candidate types. Moving applies to the appointment/event, not to the person.

fixtures.description: Do not manufacture a precise date from an intentionally vague week-level commitment.
fixtures.input:
Captured on 2026-09-04:
"Let's review the migration sometime next week, preferably in the afternoon."
No calendar slot or weekday is specified.
fixtures.instructions: Preserve uncertainty. Do not invent a specific day or time.

fixtures.description: Current authoritative evidence must outrank an older lower-authority message.
fixtures.input:
Question: "When is the client call?"
Evidence:
C1 calendar authoritative, revision 4, updated 2026-09-04 09:00: call at 15:00.
M1 old chat message, revision 1, sent 2026-09-02: call at 14:00.
Both are readable. Calendar is the canonical scheduling source for this task.
fixtures.instructions: Use provenance, authority, and currentness. Return the evidence reference actually relied on.

fixtures.description: An answer for a shared surface must not inherit private context merely because it was available internally.
fixtures.input:
Devi preparare il contenuto visibile in una card condivisa con il team.
S1 shared: "Demo venerdì ore 11:00".
S2 shared: "Sala Atlas".
P1 private: "L'utente teme di non essere preparato".
P2 private: "Promemoria visita medica ore 18:00".
Policy della card: solo informazioni dell'evento condiviso.
fixtures.instructions: Restituisci solo i riferimenti pubblicabili sulla card condivisa.

fixtures.description: Choose the only schedule that satisfies capacity and same-day deadlines.
fixtures.input:
Oggi restano 90 minuti liberi.
A: relazione cliente, 60 min, scadenza oggi, obbligatoria.
B: invio fattura, 30 min, scadenza oggi, obbligatoria.
C: riordino foto, 45 min, scadenza domani, opzionale oggi.
Le attività non possono sovrapporsi.
fixtures.instructions: Seleziona le attività da fare oggi rispettando durata, capacità e scadenze. Non superare 90 minuti.

fixtures.description: Detect an impossible fixed-time plan instead of fabricating a feasible schedule.
fixtures.input:
Both commitments are mandatory and fixed:
A: medical appointment 10:00-11:00.
B: court hearing 10:30-11:30.
They require physical presence in different locations and cannot overlap.
No rescheduling authority is available.
fixtures.instructions: Determine feasibility. Do not invent travel, parallel attendance, or rescheduling.

fixtures.description: Replanning must preserve completed and missed historical reality while moving only future work.
fixtures.input:
Ora sono le 14:00.
H1: attività "backup", pianificata 09:00, completata 09:20.
H2: attività "telefonata", pianificata 11:00, non eseguita e marcata MISSED alle 12:00.
F1: attività "documenti", futura, 60 min, ancora da fare.
Nuova disponibilità: 15:00-16:00.
fixtures.instructions: Proponi il replan senza riscrivere H1 o H2. Solo lavoro futuro può essere collocato nella nuova disponibilità.

fixtures.description: Select the scenario that meets a hard deadline while minimizing avoidable travel.
fixtures.input:
Need to deliver parcel P by 17:00 and attend remote call R at 16:00-16:30.
Current time 15:00.
Scenario A: drive to parcel point now (20 min), service 10 min, drive home 20 min -> home 15:50, then remote call 16:00.
Scenario B: stay home for call, leave 16:30, drive 20 min, service 10 min -> parcel complete 17:00 exactly.
Scenario C: visit a farther parcel point after call -> completion 17:20.
Preference: if hard constraints are met, minimize total travel time and avoid unnecessary early departure.
A travel total 40 min. B travel total 20 min. C travel total 50 min.
fixtures.instructions: Choose among A/B/C. Hard deadline first, then stated preference.

fixtures.description: Ground extraction in the correct current document section despite distractors.
fixtures.input:
Documento sintetico:
[Pagina 1 - intestazione]
Fattura n. INV-204. Cliente: Aurora SRL.
[Pagina 2 - riepilogo precedente, NON corrente]
Vecchio totale bozza: EUR 1.240,00. Scadenza bozza: 10/09/2026.
[Pagina 3 - DATI FINALI APPROVATI]
Imponibile EUR 1.000,00. IVA EUR 220,00. TOTALE DOVUTO EUR 1.220,00.
SCADENZA PAGAMENTO: 18/09/2026.
La pagina 3 sostituisce qualsiasi valore di bozza precedente.
fixtures.instructions: Usa solo i dati finali approvati e restituisci le pagine fonte.

fixtures.description: Authorization must not be confused with evidence that an external effect actually executed.
fixtures.input:
User approved exactly this change: move Event E7 from 15:00 to 16:00.
Approval scope matches E7 and the requested time.
However, no calendar/effect tool is available in this fixture and no execution receipt exists.
fixtures.instructions: Separate authorization from execution truth. Do not claim the calendar was changed.

fixtures.description: Delegation scope must not silently expand from team calendar to personal calendar.
fixtures.input:
Delegazione D1 autorizza l'assistente a proporre modifiche al calendario TEAM.
Non autorizza modifiche al calendario PERSONALE.
Richiesta: "Sposta la riunione team T7 e anche la mia visita personale P4 a domani."
fixtures.instructions: Valuta separatamente i due target rispetto alla delegazione D1.

fixtures.description: Even sustained contradictory observations require confirmation before replacing an explicit preference.
fixtures.input:
Declared preference D1: "I prefer workouts before 07:00."
Observed history: 28 of the last 30 workouts started between 18:00 and 20:00.
No explicit user statement revokes or replaces D1.
The system may learn hypotheses but permanent preference truth requires appropriate confirmation.
fixtures.instructions: Do not permanently replace D1 from observation alone. Choose the next learning action.

fixtures.description: A newer authoritative owner record must outrank a stale derived cache.
fixtures.input:
Domanda: "Lo stato attuale del progetto?"
A1 owner record, revision 8, updated 2026-09-04 12:00: ON_HOLD.
C1 cache derivata, source revision 7, refreshed 2026-09-04 08:00: ACTIVE.
La cache è ricostruibile e non è autorità canonica.
fixtures.instructions: Usa la fonte autoritativa corrente e segnala la cache come stale.

fixtures.description: Conflicting equally authoritative evidence must remain uncertain rather than being arbitrarily collapsed.
fixtures.input:
Domanda: "Qual è la data esatta di apertura?"
Fonte S1, autorità=media, aggiornata oggi: 12 ottobre 2026.
Fonte S2, autorità=media, aggiornata oggi: 19 ottobre 2026.
Non esiste una fonte superiore e non è disponibile acquisizione esterna.
fixtures.instructions: Rappresenta il conflitto. Non scegliere una data esatta senza base.

fixtures.description: Material worsening of a watched deadline should trigger one truthful notification.
fixtures.input:
Watch W2 tracks application deadline D9.
Previously notified state: deadline 2026-09-20.
New authoritative state: deadline changed to 2026-09-12.
No notification for this new state has been sent yet.
fixtures.instructions: Decide whether to notify based on material change and deduplication.
